full_judgment: 8. The learned Subordinate Judge found that the petition of complainant alleged to have been filed before the chairman, local Union Parishad on 22.4.75, although the order sheet for the same purpose was opened on 22.3.75. It may be mentioned that D.W.1 has complained on 22.3.75 before the Chairman, local Union Parishad. The certified copy of the petition Ext. A bears the date of 22.3.75 on the top also 22.3.75 at the bottom but the figure 3 was interpulated in both places. So also the date of the copy of the order sheet dated 22.3.75 although on the top the date remains intact as 22.3.75 and the order itself contained the same date. The learned subordinate Judge failed to notice this interpolation in the copies of the petition and the order sheet. Considering the evidence of D.W. 1 along with D.Ws. 3 and 4 it can safely be held that the petitioner reported in the incidence to D.W.3 and D.W.4 and D.W.3 is one of the signatories to the order dated 25.5.75 passed by the Union Parishad ex-parte in favour of the petitioner. Because of the aforesaid interpolation in cannot be said the Ext. A series were manufactured or that the incidence was not reported by the petitioner to D.Ws. 3 and 4.
